title: alchemilla vulgaris subsp. semisecta
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. semisecta, commonly known as lady's mantle, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family that is native to Europe, western Asia, and North Africa. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its anti-inflammatory and astringent properties, which provide relief from digestive issues and menstrual cramps. The health benefits of lady's mantle include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and help with menstrual irregularities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and astringent properties.
